scoring_definition: Normalised unordered set of values in the declared answer column; other fields, row order and duplicates are not graded.

fixed_protocol.allowed_inputs: id, original question, reference Cypher, returned column names, declared scored answer column
fixed_protocol.hidden_inputs: other review, demand/type/disposition labels, model predictions, item F1 and new subset aggregate scores
fixed_protocol.field_aligned: The requested result can be represented by the scored unordered value set, without omitting requested fields, counts, mappings, order or multiplicity; no evident query scope or unrequested cap mismatch
fixed_protocol.mismatch: Requested information is ungraded, or an evident query scope/cap conflicts with the question; cite the conflicting question and query/column
fixed_protocol.ambiguous: The supplied question/query leaves field, top-k, tie or scope requirements unclear; do not assume a favorable interpretation
fixed_protocol.selection: Intersection of both field_aligned judgments; any mismatch or ambiguity excludes the item; no adjudication after scores
fixed_protocol.ranking: Explicit rank/order cannot be checked by a set. Explicit top-k membership can be set-scored when k and criterion are specified.
fixed_protocol.additional_columns: An additional returned column alone is not a mismatch; compare it with the question.

limits: AI-assisted field-coverage judgments are fallible and are not expert validation or semantic correctness certification.
